note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Start the age readers once the ledger lands", the age rules reaching young writers, producers and directors as well as performers; "It should cover across every country"; "Again I want depth covering every basis for every feature leaving NO STONE UNTURNED"): what age changes for screen work in Mozambique: the age of majority, the working age, how a minor's contract binds and what of the pay is set aside, a child performer's permit and hours, the unions', the funds' and the company law's ages. Research, retry and web-search subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-ages-roles.md, BRIEF-ages-world.md, BRIEF-ages-search.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: The minimum age of admission to work is eighteen; exceptionally an employer may take on a minor who has turned fifteen with the legal representative's authorisation, never in unhealthy, dangerous or heavy tasks, for at most twenty-five hours a week and five a day; the Council of Ministers is to set by decree the kinds and conditions of work for fifteen-to-eighteen-year-olds.
figures.applies: Nationwide, from the Law's entry into force (2024).

sources.said: 1. A idade mínima de admissão para o trabalho é de 18 anos. 2. Excepcionalmente, o empregador pode admitir ao trabalho o menor que tenha completado 15 anos de idade, mediante autorização do seu representante legal. … 4. O período normal de trabalho do menor cuja idade esteja compreendida entre 15 e 18 anos não deve exceder a 25 horas semanais e cinco horas diárias. 5. Por diploma específico, o Conselho de Ministros define a natureza e condições em que, a prestação de trabalho pode ser realizada por menores com idade compreendida entre os 15 a 18 anos.

figures.finding: Artistic work is a special regime the Labour Law leaves to special legislation, the Law applying to it where it fits; the Law itself admits no one under fifteen to work, and from fifteen only with the legal representative's authorisation, at most five hours a day and twenty-five a week. The special legislation on artistic work, which might set a performer's rule, wasn't found.

sources.said: Artigo 3 (Regimes especiais) 1. São regidos por legislação especial, nomeadamente, os seguintes tipos de trabalho: a) artístico; … 3. As relações de trabalho previstas nos números 1 e 2 do presente artigo, bem como as de outros sectores cujas actividades requeiram regimes especiais, são reguladas pela presente Lei, em tudo o que se mostrar adaptado à sua natureza e características particulares.

figures.finding: Capacity to make a contract of work follows the general rules of law and the Labour Law's own rules: a minor of fifteen to seventeen is taken on with the legal representative's authorisation, and a contract made against these rules is null. No set-aside of earnings was found.
figures.applies: Nationwide; the Civil Code's general rules on minors weren't read.

sources.said: Artigo 28 (Capacidade para o trabalho) 1. A capacidade para celebrar contratos de trabalho rege-se pelas regras gerais do direito e pelas normas especiais constantes da presente Lei. … 3. O contrato de trabalho celebrado em desobediência ao regime estabelecido pelo presente artigo é considerado nulo e de nenhum efeito.
